posts.en:
dsh-plugin-vetting is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-702ddcb2463b653aff00.html
